body:
Hi, I have one follow-up question regarding the maintenance downtime and monthly submission quota.

Our team currently has 4 unused August submissions remaining (5 monthly limit / 1 used / 4 remaining), but the competition API is already CLOSED due to the Aug 31–Sep 6 maintenance period.

Since we can no longer use those August attempts before the month ends, will the unused August quota be carried over or compensated after maintenance?

This is especially important because the September submission limit is planned to be reduced to 3.

Thanks for clarifying.
title: [e2e challenge] Unable to use remaining August submissions due to planned maintenance downtime
